Warning policy

The threshold is recalibrated from past out-of-sample scores and matured outcomes only, to hold at most 2.0 false episodes per year and keep at most 10% of sessions in alarm, over a 1260-session lookback needing 252 matured outcomes. 68 recalibrations so far. the threshold is chosen from past out-of-sample scores and matured outcomes only. A frozen threshold is a policy, not a proof that the future false-alarm budget will be met
